title: Forklift operating near seated worker
location: Central aisle, right side near workstation
observation: A forklift carrying a load of orange bins is observed moving through the aisle in close proximity to a worker seated at a workstation. The forklift passes within a few feet of the worker.
risk_interpretation: The proximity of a moving heavy vehicle to a stationary worker creates a risk of collision or injury from falling objects. The worker is seated and may have limited mobility or awareness.
recommended_actions: Verify that the aisle width and layout provide adequate clearance for forklifts and pedestrians.; Ensure the forklift operator maintains a safe distance from the worker.; Consider physical barriers or designated pedestrian walkways if the area is high-traffic.; Confirm the worker is wearing appropriate PPE.
unknowns: Worker's PPE status (e.g., high-vis vest); Forklift operator's line of sight; Specific clearance distance maintained; Whether the path is a designated pedestrian walkway or a shared aisle

title: Unsecured red bin/cart near machinery
location: Near the blue and white hydraulic press on the right
observation: A red bin or small cart is positioned on the floor near the base of a hydraulic press. It appears stationary but is not clearly secured.
risk_interpretation: If the bin is not secured, it could be knocked over by the forklift or machinery vibration, creating a tripping hazard or obstruction.
recommended_actions: Inspect the red bin/cart to ensure it is stable and not a tripping hazard.; Secure the bin or relocate it to a designated storage area if not in use.
unknowns: Whether the bin is intended to be there; If it is secured or just placed
